title: Day 12: an AI made an escape room where every lock is a crossword #shorts
description:
Escape room, but every lock is a crossword.

Lockword is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

You're locked in an old manor at night. Every object in the room, from the portrait to the grandfather clock, hides a tiny crossword, and the word you solve becomes a real tool. Solve KEY and you get a key that opens the locked chest. Collect the marked letters to open the final door. Plus a five-minute puzzle nook every day.

Lockword - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video was generated for this channel with Stable Audio. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 13 tomorrow.
